newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia's 12 loss-makers to be restructured soon.
newsitem.headline: Croatia's 12 loss-makers to be restructured soon.

text.p: Rehabilitation of Croatia's five loss-making shipyards and seven public sector firms will be completed by the end of the year, state news agency HINA reported on Monday.
After completing the restructuring, a new ownership structure will be introduced, HINA said.
Among the firms were steel maker Sisak, food processor Pazinka and textile firm Dalmatinka.
The World Bank has granted Croatia technical assistance worth $5 million for extensive economic and financial sector reforms.
The reforms will touch state firms, including national oil utility INA and railways and a radical banking overhaul.
